finding.finding: Payagala site S03 is reported equipment-faulted at observed minute 0 and equipment-normal at observed minute 5; both authoritative reports are preserved.

S03 equipment status is unresolved because two verified observations conflict. S03 is the only fault indicated by the resolved state; no road, link, or grid-power faults are recorded. Crew C3 is already at S03 and has equipment skill, and EQ-S03 is available. Uncertainty alone is not a reason to defer work.
